tasks.title: Implement getRevalidationToken helper
tasks.description: Create a shared helper function to retrieve and normalize the revalidation token.
tasks.details:
1. Create a `getRevalidationToken()` function.
2. Inside the function, read `process.env.REVALIDATION_TOKEN`.
3. Normalize the casing to match the expected format.
4. Throw an error if the token is missing.
5. Use this helper in both `/api/revalidate` and `/api/revalidate-all` routes.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests to verify the helper function correctly retrieves and normalizes the token.
2. Test that an error is thrown when the token is missing.
3. Integration tests to ensure the revalidation endpoints function correctly with the helper.

tasks.title: Refactor /api/revalidate* endpoints
tasks.description: Update the revalidation endpoints to use the new `getRevalidationToken` helper and add rate limiting.
tasks.details:
1.  Import and use `getRevalidationToken()` in `/api/revalidate` and `/api/revalidate-all`.
2.  Implement basic rate limiting (e.g., using a library like `p-limit` or a simple in-memory counter).
3.  Consider adding `Authorization` header validation.
4.  Log denied attempts.
tasks.testStrategy:
1.  Unit tests for rate limiting logic.
2.  Integration tests to verify revalidation endpoints with valid and invalid tokens, and rate limiting.

tasks.title: Address Redis Cache Hard Dependency
tasks.description: Modify the Redis cache usage to gracefully handle missing credentials.
tasks.details:
1. Wrap the credential lookup in a guard that returns `undefined` when Upstash variables are missing.
2. Have `withMongooseCache` bail out before touching Redis in that case.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests to ensure the guard correctly handles missing credentials.
2. Integration tests to verify authentication requests do not crash when Redis is unavailable.

tasks.title: Migrate Listing Reviews Data Fetching
tasks.description: Move the fetching of listing reviews to the server data layer.
tasks.details:
1.  Modify the `app/listings/[slug]/page.tsx` file.
2.  Replace the ad-hoc Promise wrapper in Params with the standard App Router signature.
3.  Move `fetchReviews` onto the server data layer (e.g., reuse the Mongo aggregation in app/api/reviews).
4.  Apply `cache()` or `revalidateTag` as appropriate.
tasks.testStrategy:
1.  Unit tests for the server data layer function.
2.  Integration tests to verify reviews are fetched correctly and caching is working as expected.

tasks.title: Upgrade NextAuth

tasks.title: Remove or Feature-Flag Test Routes

tasks.details:

tasks.details: 1.  Invoke the reviews data layer directly (or a server action) so the page can share database access and Next.js caching without brittle environment assumptions.
